summary: Created a Vue.js marketing landing page at site/index.html with Destiny/Call of Duty inspired design. Features: hero section, Ahamkara project overview (4 feature cards), Wish platform explanation (4 feature cards), Inspiration section (4 inspirations), responsive layout, animated stars background, glassmorphism cards, placeholder SVG logo, and 13 automated validation checks. The page uses Vue.js 3 via CDN (no build step needed) and all styling is inline CSS with CSS custom properties for theme consistency.

test_details.execution_guide: Run `python3 tests/validate_landing_page.py` from repo root to verify page content and structure.
test_details.expected_output: All 13 checks PASS (file existence, Vue.js CDN, responsive meta, all sections present, Vue app mount, stars effect, card grid, hero, scroll hint, responsive media query)
test_details.failure_indicators: Any check reporting FAIL (will exit with code 1)
